The Falcons host the 49ers in NFL regular-season play at Mercedes-Benz Stadium. San Francisco arrives unbeaten at 6-0 and winners of six straight, while Atlanta sits at 2-4 after back-to-back losses with 31-23 being the most recent loss to Chicago.
